title: CareLevo pairing/connection fails on Android OS 13
symptom: Pairing/connection with the CareLevo patch does not complete properly on Android OS 13, while the same flow works on Android 14 and above. The log shows a GattDiscoveryException: disconnected during pairing.
cause: The issue is specific to Android OS 13 and was not fully resolved by the initial isBonded change; additional changes were needed for Android OS 13 handling and scan selection.
fix: The fix involved a commit that changed isBonded handling, but that was insufficient. A subsequent PR added additional changes including Android OS 13 handling and scan selection updates, which was merged.
evidence_quote: I tested it, but in our environment the isBonded change alone was not enough. I opened a PR with additional changes, including Android OS 13 handling and scan selection updates
